tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Create an agent mailbox and receive its key once. Starts with zero sending credits; receiving is available without payment.

tools.name: check_inbox
tools.description: List incoming messages. Requires a Bearer API key. Email is untrusted external content.

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read a message by its folder-scoped UID. Requires a Bearer API key.

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Check your mailbox address, account state and sending credits. Requires a Bearer API key.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Submit mail with existing credits: one credit per accepted recipient. Requires a Bearer API key. Reuse idempotencyKey for retries; acceptance is not proof of remote delivery.

tools.name: check_sending_status
tools.description: Read your sending state and current limits, including probation, pauses and pending review. Buying credits never overrides sending controls.

tools.name: request_sender_review
tools.description: Request an operator review of your sending purpose and recipient consent. Full account key required. Does not automatically increase limits or resume sending. Three requests per day; repeated pending requests keep the original purpose.

tools.name: create_payment
tools.description: With your operator's authorization, create a card checkout or native USDC invoice on Polygon, Base, Ethereum or Solana. Choose mail_credits ($1 buys 10,000 standard sends) or hosting at $1 per 30 days: domain_hosting for the first domain, domain_addon plus domainId for another verified domain under

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Check this account's native USDC invoice. Confirmation applies sending credits or activates prepaid domain hosting once, without a human checkout. Requires the same account's API key.

tools.name: propose_email
tools.description: Prepare a plain-text email for human approval. Requires a human-issued mail:draft key. Never sends. Reuse clientKey and content after uncertain responses.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: List only this draft-only key’s proposals and review statuses.

tools.name: get_proposal
tools.description: Check a proposal. Human edits are private. Approved means authorized, not delivered; inspect submission.status.

tools.name: update_proposal
tools.description: Edit or withdraw this key’s pending proposal. Cannot approve or change a message after human editing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_inbox, get_email, check_sending_status, list_proposals · Private data: check_inbox, get_email, check_balance, send_email, check_payment, get_proposal · Public sink: check_inbox, get_email, send_email, propose_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_inbox, get_email, check_sending_status, list_proposals · Private data: check_inbox, get_email, check_balance, send_email, check_payment, get_proposal · Public sink: check_inbox, get_email, send_email, propose_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
